assets.name: Linda Rotta
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied original SEGA Linda Rotta full-body render from Zombie Revenge (1999) into ONE production-ready 2D fighting-game base sprite of the SAME adult character, with genuine transparent background. Reference image is the authoritative identity and costume source. Preserve her exact golden-blonde asymmetric short bob with side fringe and longer front strand, serious face, yellow cropped sleeveless tank top, two black belt straps and stacked silver buckles, frayed blue denim shorts, white wrap around LEFT upper arm, full-finger purple-blue gloves, brown double-strap holster on RIGHT thigh, bare legs, yellow sneakers with blue-purple side details and white soles, and silver-and-dark pistol. Do not replace shorts with trousers or sneakers with boots. Full body from hair to both soles completely inside frame with 8% safety margin. Adapt only the stance and medium: three-quarter lateral combat view facing RIGHT, feet planted at the same ground line, knees slightly flexed, pistol held low and safely toward screen right, free hand ready near the chest, composed alert neutral stance. Detailed hand-painted arcade fighting sprite, crisp controllable silhouette and restrained fine outlines, readable material shading, realistic original body proportions. No scenery, floor, shadow, text, name label, panel, extra character, duplicated pose, particles or glow. Preserve the original distinctive costume and identity rather than redesigning them. Portrait framing around 1024x1536.
assets.limits: Pose de base adaptée en 2D depuis le rendu officiel. Main armée corrigée. Fidélité exacte et animation non certifiées.

assets.name: Yoko
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Adapt only YOKO, the adult rescued civilian from SEGA Zombie Revenge (1999), from the attached game screenshots and manual into one clean high-detail hand-painted 2D dialogue character portrait with transparent background. Image 1: authoritative in-game skin, hair, outfit, jewelry colors. Image 2: authoritative face and hair details. Image 3: manual reference; select ONLY the woman at upper right, do not draw ZED or any page text. Preserve her exact shoulder-length straight dark chestnut hair swept back at crown, slim adult facial features, original silver necklace with oval piece and long pendant, deep charcoal-black tailored short dress with wide lapels, shoulder cutouts, long sleeves with ragged cuffs, thin silver chain belt with oval buckle and silver wrist jewelry. Neutral confident civilian expression, one hand on hip and the other offering a small plain 3.5-inch floppy disk. NOT a soldier, no gun, no fantasy gear. Intentional dialogue portrait from crown through upper thighs only, looking slightly RIGHT in gentle three-quarter view; head and arms fully inside with 10 percent margin. Match the body proportions and mature appearance of original screenshots. Crisp controlled painted contours, detailed fabric without redesign. No background, warehouse, boxes, floor, ground shadow, frame, text, subtitles, labels, watermarks, additional characters or multiple poses. True transparent alpha around the single character. Portrait canvas approximately 1024x1536. End the portrait cleanly at upper thighs, do not fabricate lower legs or shoes not visible in the source.
assets.limits: Portrait limité aux parties visibles dans les références; ce fichier n'est pas un sprite de combat en pied. Adaptation 2D, fidélité exacte non certifiée.

Preserve this character's identity very closely: dark brown skin, youthful adult masculine face with original broad jaw, serious eyes, neutral closed mouth, long slender black dreadlock strands around both sides of face and behind neck, flat-brim olive green baseball cap. Exact white lettering on front of cap: "A.M.S.". Preserve the original cap's proportions, green hue, facial geometry, hair length and gentle three-quarter turn. Remove scan noise and old low-resolution grain. No background, glow, ground shadow, text outside the original A.M.S. cap lettering, name tag, label, collage or extra person. Square 1024x1024.
